The new `as_index` branch accepts and preserves a flat tuple-label `pd.Index` for a network with MultiIndex snapshots. But `model_snapshots` only converts MultiIndex inputs to flat labels; with `"multiindex"` (or `"auto"` under legacy semantics), it leaves an already-flat input unchanged. Thus `create_model` can pass flat snapshots onward when the selected representation requires a MultiIndex, including with transmission losses disabled.
